comment: The effects the spells, the statuses and the generator's affixes wear: 12 a race and the Hybrid Reaver's own. A look with a ramp repaints the unit; one with rule "none" is an aura alone, a line of light on the outline and a glow past it, so it goes over whatever paint the unit already has. The names are what an affix or a generated record asks for by name. Presentation only: no replay or fingerprint sees this file. The rules "none", the material "paint" and the aura block are read by the design and studio builds today; see API-NEEDS.md, "Auras in the shipped build".

looks.name: ls-t-ember
looks.about: Dark red carapace lit from within, with a low ember light on the ground. Burning.

looks.name: ls-t-slag
looks.about: Cooling slag: a crust over heat, slow and heavy. Slagged.

looks.name: ls-t-ironclad
looks.about: Pale steel with a hot barrel and no light of its own.

looks.name: ls-t-arc
looks.about: Jagged electricity jumping along the outline. Jammed, and Null Pulse's own flash.

looks.name: ls-t-drone-lume
looks.about: A small machine lit by its own lamp, cold white over grey.

looks.name: ls-t-rangefinder
looks.about: A thin amber line round the unit, pulsing in time. Marked for the barrage.

looks.name: ls-t-thermite
looks.about: White-hot: the outline overexposed, specks falling off it. Thermite Spray.

looks.name: ls-t-weldglow
looks.about: Short bright flares along the hull, as a weld runs. Mending.

looks.name: ls-t-clamp-spark
looks.about: The line broken into pieces, with a flash as the clamp bites. Clamped.

looks.name: ls-t-overclock
looks.about: Fine wisps flowing off the outline, a red core going white. Overclocked.

looks.name: ls-t-smokeveil
looks.about: A soft grey haze with no line, hiding the unit's edges. Veiled.

looks.name: ls-t-anchorplate
looks.about: Plates settling: two slow bands round the feet. Anchored.

looks.name: ls-z-acid
looks.about: Chitin eaten back to a wet green, running at the edges. Corroded.

looks.name: ls-z-bile
looks.about: A sick yellow film over the body, blistering. Bile rot.

looks.name: ls-z-spore
looks.about: Ochre dust drifting off the unit, thick and slow. Spored.

looks.name: ls-z-tendril
looks.about: Dark roots gripping the ground under it, held still. Rooted and Hobbled.

looks.name: ls-z-brood
looks.about: Brood violet with a pale underside: what the spawn comes out of.

looks.name: ls-z-infested
looks.about: A husk taken over: grey metal gone soft, lit orange at the seams.

looks.name: ls-z-knit
looks.about: Flesh closing: a green line that breathes with the heal. Knit.

looks.name: ls-z-chitin
looks.about: Carapace gone hard and pale, like bone. Hardened carapace.

looks.name: ls-z-frenzy
looks.about: A fast red line, boiling in place. Frenzied.

looks.name: ls-z-gorged
looks.about: Swollen and dark, veins standing out. Gorged.

looks.name: ls-z-hive
looks.about: A thin shared line, every linked unit in time with the rest. Hive-linked.

looks.name: ls-z-molt
looks.about: The old shell coming away in flakes. Molting.

looks.name: ls-p-psi
looks.about: Psionic gold over the whole sprite, brightest at the head. Mind-burned.

looks.name: ls-p-void
looks.about: Violet over the whole sprite, its blades the brightest part, a violet light under it.

looks.name: ls-p-rift
looks.about: A rift holding the unit in place, white at the core. Rifted, and Chrono Rift's burst.

looks.name: ls-p-dilation
looks.about: Pale blue, almost still: the unit lagging behind itself. Dilated.

looks.name: ls-p-tether
looks.about: A dark line dragging one way, as if pulled. Tethered.

looks.name: ls-p-null
looks.about: The glow pulled inward and gone out: nothing will fire. Nulled.

looks.name: ls-p-khala
looks.about: The shield's blue over every entry, brightest at its heart, a wide blue light.

looks.name: ls-p-shieldweave
looks.about: A woven shell, three bands turning slowly. Shield-woven.

looks.name: ls-p-phase
looks.about: Half out of the world: a faint line and a quick drift. Phased.

looks.name: ls-p-warplag
looks.about: The outline trailing a step behind the body. Warp lag.

looks.name: ls-p-echo
looks.about: A copy that is not quite there: everything one shade toward white.

looks.name: ls-p-storm
looks.about: Storm blue with a charged line: what marks the ground before it breaks.

looks.name: ls-hybrid
looks.about: Zerg brown under Protoss gold, the two halves split by tone: the Hybrid Reaver's own.
